allocations_target.name: allocations_target
allocations_target.value: ("allocations"."kind" <> 'invoice' or "allocations"."invoice_id" is not null) and ("allocations"."kind" <> 'document' or "allocations"."document_id" is not null)

allocations_tax.name: allocations_tax
allocations_tax.value: case when "allocations"."kind"::text = 'steuer' then "allocations"."tax_type" is not null and "allocations"."tax_year" is not null and "allocations"."tax_item" is not null else "allocations"."tax_type" is null and "allocations"."tax_year" is null and "allocations"."tax_item" is null end

allocations_kategorie.name: allocations_kategorie
allocations_kategorie.value: case when "allocations"."kind"::text = 'kategorie' then "allocations"."category" is not null and "allocations"."tax_rate" is not null else "allocations"."category" is null and "allocations"."tax_rate" is null end

allocations_loan.name: allocations_loan
allocations_loan.value: case when "allocations"."kind"::text = 'darlehen' then "allocations"."loan_id" is not null and "allocations"."loan_part" is not null else "allocations"."loan_id" is null and "allocations"."loan_part" is null end

assets_degressive_rate.name: assets_degressive_rate
assets_degressive_rate.value: ("assets"."method" = 'degressiv') = ("assets"."degressive_rate" is not null) and coalesce("assets"."degressive_rate", 1) between 1 and 3000

bank_accounts_provider.name: bank_accounts_provider
bank_accounts_provider.value:
("bank_accounts"."purpose" = 'zahlungsdienstleister' and "bank_accounts"."provider" is not null and "bank_accounts"."ledger_index" between 1 and 9 and "bank_accounts"."iban" is null)
      or ("bank_accounts"."purpose" <> 'zahlungsdienstleister' and "bank_accounts"."provider" is null and "bank_accounts"."ledger_index" is null and "bank_accounts"."iban" is not null)

cash_entries_einnahme.name: cash_entries_einnahme
cash_entries_einnahme.value: case when "cash_entries"."kind" = 'einnahme' then "cash_entries"."tax_treatment" is not null and "cash_entries"."tax_rate" is not null else "cash_entries"."tax_treatment" is null and "cash_entries"."tax_rate" is null end

invoices_final_has_number.name: invoices_final_has_number
invoices_final_has_number.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."locked_at" is not null)

invoices_plan_row.name: invoices_plan_row
invoices_plan_row.value: "invoices"."payment_plan_row" is null or ("invoices"."variant" = 'abschlag' and "invoices"."quote_id" is not null and "invoices"."payment_plan_row" >= 0)

lsta_submissions_zeitraum.name: lsta_submissions_zeitraum
lsta_submissions_zeitraum.value: ("lsta_submissions"."zeitraum" between 1 and 12) or ("lsta_submissions"."zeitraum" between 41 and 44) or "lsta_submissions"."zeitraum" = 19

payslips_final_has_pdf.name: payslips_final_has_pdf
payslips_final_has_pdf.value: "payslips"."locked_at" is null or ("payslips"."pdf" is not null and "payslips"."sha256" is not null)

quotes_final_has_number.name: quotes_final_has_number
quotes_final_has_number.value: "quotes"."status" = 'draft' or ("quotes"."number" is not null and "quotes"."locked_at" is not null)

sv_portal_filings_protokoll.name: sv_portal_filings_protokoll
sv_portal_filings_protokoll.value: ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_sha256" is null) = ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_dateiname" is null) and ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_sha256" is null) = ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_groesse" is null) and ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_sha256" is null) = ("sv_portal_filings"."protokoll_mime_type" is null)

write_offs_target.name: write_offs_target
write_offs_target.value: ("write_offs"."kind" = 'skontoErhalten' and "write_offs"."document_id" is not null and "write_offs"."invoice_id" is null) or ("write_offs"."kind" in ('skonto', 'forderungsausfall') and "write_offs"."invoice_id" is not null and "write_offs"."document_id" is null) or ("write_offs"."kind" = 'kursdifferenz' and ("write_offs"."invoice_id" is null) <> ("write_offs"."document_id" is null) and "write_offs"."transaction_id" is not null)
